summary: Server component of esv::lookat::StateSystem: how long the current look-at request of an entity still lasts. Holds the request id and a timer; its values match esv::lookat::ChangedOneFrameComponent (+0x10 id, +0xC duration). Seen.py context: dialogues and fights.

fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2B42C30 (AllocRaw 0x18) zeroes +0 and +8. Live (48): random 16-byte values, the same set of values as ChangedOneFrameComponent +0x10 (look-at request id).

fields.name: TimeLeft
fields.evidence: Creator default 0x7f7fffff (FLT_MAX). Live: 1.47..2.16 s or 9999999 - below the Duration of the matching ChangedOneFrameComponent (2.3..2.5), so a countdown.

fields.name: _Pad14
fields.evidence: Not written by the creator; live values random (0..0xFFFFFFFF) - alignment padding.
